title: Fix typos and unclear sentences in the Session 1 notes
body:
## Problem
The Session 1 notes may contain typos or sentences that a first-year student finds confusing.

## Context
Beginners judge the whole repo by Session 1.

## Expected outcome
A clearer `sessions/session-01/README.md` and `lesson.py` comments.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`, `sessions/session-01/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] At least three improvements
- [ ] `python start.py test` still passes

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add a second synthetic table to the Session 1 app
body:
## Problem
The Session 1 app filters one table of 12 students; learners ask what a second table would look like.

## Context
Session 2 introduces keys and joins, so a gentle preview would help.

## Expected outcome
A second small table (for example subjects) drawn beside the first in the app, with no new sliders.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/app.html`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] The app still passes the checks in `python start.py test`
- [ ] Screenshot added to the pull request

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add Session 4: composite and covering indexes
body:
## Problem
The roadmap's first milestone does not exist yet.

## Context
See `promo/roadmap.md`. Session 3 shows that a single-column index still needs a temporary sort for a range query ordered by another column.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-04/` with README (sections A to F), lesson, checkpoint, exercises and app in the same style as Sessions 1 to 3.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`, `sessions/session-03/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Checkpoint prints PASS and the roadmap checkpoint is met
- [ ] Added to the tests

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Add window functions to the canteen mini-project
body:
## Problem
The canteen reports in Session 3 use GROUP BY only; running totals need window functions.

## Context
Roadmap milestone 2.

## Expected outcome
A lesson section and checkpoint check where a SQL running total per customer is compared with numpy cumsum.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-03/lesson.py`, `promo/roadmap.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] SQL and numpy agree for all 8 customers
- [ ] Checkpoint added

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Reproduce the Target: an animated query visualiser
body:
## Problem
The Target animation shows a filter, a join and a scan-versus-index race; there is no public implementation.

## Context
The code behind the Target is private on purpose. The roadmap gives the path.

## Expected outcome
Your own implementation, written from the roadmap, plus an animation like the Target.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Shows rows passing a filter, join lines and a plan for a small table
- [ ] Short write-up of your method

## Difficulty
advanced

title: Translate the Session 1 notes into Hindi
body:
## Problem
Students who prefer Hindi cannot read Session 1 comfortably.

## Context
This project teaches first- and second-year students across India; translations widen who can join.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-01/README.hi.md` with a faithful Hindi translation of sections A to F, linked from the main README.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] All sections translated
- [ ] Equations, code blocks and file names unchanged
- [ ] Link added to the main README

## Difficulty
beginner
